parsed.notes:
Minimum Qualifications defaults to required; Preferred Qualifications makes its items nice_to_have. Technologies appearing only in Key Responsibilities were excluded.
The GCP-services/open-source-ecosystems wording is treated as one alternative tool ask; its four concrete tools share group 2, while the named platform stays outside the examples group. MLOps is independently required by the services qualification and therefore leaves group 1.
Fragments for tools repeated in responsibilities include enough adjacent text to identify the qualification mention.
Group 7 includes Grafana and the unmapped Datadog; only the taxonomy-mapped member can be represented in expected.
Agent Development Kit is explicitly described as an internal equivalent, so it is not assumed to be Google ADK.
Debugging alone is not treated as Software Testing. Continuous training, ML pipelines, and large-scale data processing are not silently mapped to broader or different practices.
Specific evaluation metrics, access control, and encryption are retained as unmapped techniques in addition to the explicitly supported broad skills.
Knowledge-transfer and service-transition programs are read literally as organizational experience rather than a named technical practice; leadership, communication, analytical ability, and stakeholder management are excluded as soft skills.
